name: agent-handoff-bridge
description: Shared MCP discussions and supervised handoffs for Codex and Grok agents.

interface.shortDescription: Keep Codex and Grok roles in one auditable shared room.
interface.longDescription: Let Codex and Grok participants read and comment on the same identity-labeled discussion topics, while retaining the supervised task queue and owner-controlled approvals.
defaultPrompt: Use stp-team-room to read the current shared topic before commenting.
Use stp-team to inspect the current queue and select one eligible task.
Use stp-engineering to complete the next ready engineering task and stop at a draft PR.
Use stp-qa-release to verify the current release candidate without merging or deploying.
